title: Bringing the People Back In: Contesting Benchmark Machine Learning Datasets
reasoning: The paper's core thesis is to propose a research program for investigating the ethics of machine learning dataset creation. It explicitly focuses on the "histories, values, and norms embedded in such datasets" and aims to develop a framework for data scientists that is "aligned with ethical principles and values." This focus on the values and ethical dimensions of data practices is central to the entire paper, not just a peripheral section.
